fragile
in glass cases; Why is it

round the stonework archways)

elaborate defences keep
things that are no longer
(much)
worth defending?

frankfort:
I taste a liquor never brewed -
From Tankards scooped in Pearl -
Not all the Frankfort Berries
Yield such an Alcohol!
Inebriate of air - am I -
And Debauchee of Dew -
Reeling - thro' endless summer days -
From inns of molten Blue -
I taste a liquor never brewed (Fr)
fratellanza: The boys at first were very polite about my medals and asked me what I had done to get them. After that their manner changed a little toward me, although I was their friend against outsiders.
fraternity: His livid face is a bewildered false green. I notice it, between the chest's hard air, with the fraternity of knowing I will also be so.
franco: I am for the legal government of Republican Spain against Franco, since Spain herself, at a properly conducted election, chose that Government and rejected the party which now supports Franco. I see no reason why this inferior modern copy of them should succeed.
